lon.name: Lon Anik
lon.bio: Play-by-play. Treats every prelim like the moon landing. Has a stat and a controversy for everyone.

blow.name: Blow Hogan
blow.bio: Color. Black belt in jiu-jitsu, white belt in staying on topic. Elk, DMT, chimps, and glazing.

dc.name: "Chicken Man" Sandwich Cormier
dc.bio: Color. Two-time Olympic wrestler, one-time chicken-wing world record holder. Gets texts from everyone. Remembers nobody's name.

braille.name: Braille Sonnen
braille.bio: Guest analyst. Legally blind. Spiritually confident.

biscuit.name: Michael Biscuit
biscuit.bio: Guest analyst. Former champ, one working eye, zero filter. Will take the other one out to make a point.

{event}. The main event. Our broadcast partners are nervous. Our insurance providers are nervous. I am thrilled.
open_title: This is for the {belt}. Twenty-five minutes, if needed, to determine the best on the planet. Or at least the best in this building.

A world title fight here at {venue}. History is a strange thing, Blow. It's being written tonight, and it's being written in blood.
The {belt} sits cageside. It weighs eleven pounds. It's worth more than that. It's worth everything to these two.
